# `aitbc platform init-platform`

Initialize a white-label platform brand manifest in the output directory.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc platform init-platform [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Platform name |
| `--template` | text | `default` | no | Template name |
| `--output` | text | `.` | no | Output directory |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc platform init-platform --name <name>
aitbc platform init-platform --name <name> --output json
```
